name: PostHog social card — desktop-window composition by posthog.com
description: A 1200×630 social card that stages PostHog's desktop-OS landing metaphor: a full-bleed sage-green low-poly landscape with a thin browser-chrome strip and orange CTA pill, plus a floating cream window carrying the lockup, a heavy black headline with a blue selection-highlight phrase, and a nested get-started panel containing a two-tone monospace command chip. Focal order reads wordmark → headline → highlighted phrase → command chip, while small labelled shortcut icons flank the window to sustain the OS conceit. Flat shapes, large radii, a single soft shadow and roughly three colours (sage, cream, ink) keep the card legible even at thumbnail size.
